project_info.theme: Authoritative uniformed speaker under an event spotlight
project_info.creative_direction: press photography and photojournalism at a fictional public forum
project_info.color_palette: dark olive green, black, warm wood, blue and white sign, cool navy audience shadows, and neutral stage light

main_subject.detail: adult blonde woman with platinum hair pulled into a neat low bun, clean professional makeup, focused forward gaze, determined expression, strong upright posture, and confident speaking presence
main_subject.wardrobe: tailored dark olive military-style service jacket with colorful ribbon racks, silver badges, sleeve chevrons, and gold buttons, paired with a tailored olive skirt, sheer black tights, and black pointed-toe pumps
main_subject.action: standing behind a wooden podium and speaking into two microphones

composition_elements.framing: slight low-angle full-body to medium-full press photograph in a 4:5 vertical frame
composition_elements.subject_position: speaker behind the podium, body angled slightly left with head facing forward, clear glass teleprompter panel to the left
composition_elements.background: fictional seated audience and event officials in soft focus, no recognizable public figures, with a blue-and-white podium sign reading BORDER OF PEACE

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: bright stadium spotlights at approximately 4200K with cooler ambient audience light and subtle overhead rim
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sharp subject focus, controlled highlights on hair and uniform buttons, darker audience background, high-ISO event grain, and cinematic tension

technical_specs.render_style: professional press camera with 200mm telephoto lens compression, photojournalistic realism
technical_specs.finish: natural digital grain, realistic fabric and skin texture, restrained contrast, no artificial glamour retouching

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult blonde woman delivers a speech at a wooden podium in a fictional public forum. She has platinum blonde hair sleekly pulled into a neat low bun, clean professional makeup, a focused forward gaze, intense determined energy, and a serious resolute expression. She wears a highly tailored dark olive military-style service uniform jacket with colorful ribbon racks on the chest, silver badges, sleeve chevrons, and gold buttons, paired with a tailored olive skirt, sheer black tights, and black pointed-toe pumps. Her body faces slightly left while her head faces forward; she stands firmly behind the podium and speaks into two black microphones, with a clear glass teleprompter panel positioned to the left. The wooden podium carries a blue-and-white sign reading BORDER OF PEACE. Use a slight low angle, full-body to medium-full 4:5 press photograph, stadium spotlights on the speaker, darker ambient audience light, 200mm telephoto compression, sharp subject focus, subtle high-ISO grain, and fictional seated officials in the background with no recognizable public figures. Keep the tone authoritative and professional rather than sexualized.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, eroticized styling, ambiguous age, recognizable public figures, celebrity likeness, political impersonation, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, illegible sign, random insignia, text artifacts
